### automaticPadding

<a id="boundspolicy"></a>

### boundsPolicy

```ts
boundsPolicy:
  | "Ballistic"
  | "Kill"
  | "Contain"
  | FluidBoundsPolicy;
```

Behavior at the finite spatialGridOptions.maxBounds cap, not intermediate adaptive edges. Defaults to Ballistic.
Quality limits do not act as physical caps.

### cfl?

Maximum travel per cell per step. Defaults to 2.

### priority?
